# cJSON

Vendored, unmodified copy of [cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON) v1.7.19, released under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`). It is used only to parse the monitor configuration and is compiled with `CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT=16`.
